fact: PHU in-charges compile community health data on a paper form (HF6) and report to the district office, where the DHMT M&E focal point enters it into the national DHIS2 database; timely community-indicator reporting rose from 74.1% in 2018 to 83.2% in 2019.
title: Enhancing access and use of community level health data for children and women through an improved community health information system in Sierra Leone
